{{Quote|Governor Chornarov is merely a corrupt politician. His private army's leader, General Ortol, is a mass-murderer. Ortol sent thousands of innocent Ord Mantellians to their deaths.|[[Satele Shan]]|<ref name="Cademimu" />}}
'''Ortol''' was a [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Galactic Republic and the Reconstituted Sith Empire. During his time on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] he committed for numerous war-crimes and was responsible for the deaths of thousands of civilians. After the movement was suppresed and Ortol fled the planet with his remaining loyalists, [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Chornarov]] of [[Cademimu V]] offered him and his soldiers amnesty for their crimes in exchange for aiding him in [[Cademimu uprising|seizing]] Cademimu V and its vast military stockpile for himself after charges of corruption were brought against him by the [[Senate]]. While the uprising was initially successful, later records show that Ortol and his forces were defeated soon afterward by a strike team, although it is unknown whether this team was sent by the Republic or the Empire.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
